errors.evidence: The figure contains two pie charts with 8 slices on the left and 10 slices on the right, not 16 total slices.
8.51% corresponds to ‘判断’ in the right pie chart, not ‘身体’.
4.26% corresponds to ‘帮助’ or ‘交通’ in the right pie chart, not ‘判断’; ‘判断’ is 8.51%.
5.32% corresponds to ‘表情’ or ‘际遇’ in the right pie chart, not ‘表达’.
